title: Best ISO 27001 compliance software
content_html:
The best ISO 27001 compliance software depends on where your work gets stuck. ISO 27001 is the international standard for managing information security. Vanta suits teams that want automated evidence collection across many tools. Assure, from Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl), suits teams whose main problem is ISO 27001 document control, and it is in beta. No software grants certification.

What is ISO 27001 compliance software

ISO 27001 compliance software is a tool that helps a company do the work the standard asks for and keep a record of it. The standard comes from ISO (the International Organization for Standardization). An external audit decides whether a company is certified. The software does not.

The work splits into two kinds:

  • Evidence: showing that controls actually run, often by pulling data from the systems a company uses.
  • Documents: policies, procedures and registers that need an owner, a current version and a review trail.

Most buying mistakes come from choosing a tool built for one kind of work when the team's problem is the other kind.

Vanta

According to its website (read November 2026), Vanta automates compliance work for ISO 27001 and several other frameworks. It says it gathers evidence automatically, monitors systems continuously and pulls data from more than 400 tools through its integrations. The site also lists a Trust Center for sharing your compliance status, automation for security questionnaires and a vendor risk product. It also offers an API for custom integrations.

Vanta is the stronger choice when your evidence is spread across many cloud tools, or when you need several frameworks at once. A document control tool does not replace it for that work.

Assure (Upward Technologies)

Assure is an ISO 27001 document control product from Upward Technologies, and it is in beta. It is aimed at the document side of the standard, not at broad evidence collection across your tool stack. Because it is in beta, check its current state before you plan an audit around it.

Spreadsheet and shared folder

Some teams keep the risk register in a spreadsheet and the policies in a shared folder. This can work while the set is small and one person owns it. It gets harder when several people edit the same files and nobody can tell which version is current. If that is where you are now, this guide on when to replace Excel with custom software covers the warning signs.

Custom software

Some companies have a security process that no standard tool matches. Then a custom build can follow the process instead of forcing the team around a package. This is the slowest route to start and only makes sense when the standard tools truly do not fit.

How to choose the best ISO 27001 compliance software

Start with the problem, not the feature list. These questions decide most cases:

1. Is your bottleneck evidence or documents? Evidence across many tools points to an automation platform such as Vanta. Documents with unclear versions and owners point to document control.
2. How many frameworks do you need? If ISO 27001 is one of several, a platform that covers several frameworks saves you running parallel tools.
3. Do customers send you security questionnaires? If so, check whether the tool can answer them or share your status with customers.
4. Where does your data go? Read each vendor's terms on where data is stored and processed. Do not assume.
5. How mature does the tool need to be? An established product and a product in beta carry different risks before an audit.
6. Who keeps it up to date? A tool nobody owns goes stale, whatever it costs.

Where Upward Technologies fits

Upward Technologies is a small Dutch software company in Breda. It builds custom software, automation and AI agents, and it hosts and runs what it builds. Assure is its ISO 27001 document control product, and it is in beta.

Be clear about the limits:

  • If you need broad automated evidence collection across many cloud tools, Vanta is the better fit.
  • Assure is in beta. It is not a finished product to build an audit deadline on without checking first.
  • Upward Technologies does not hold ISO 27001 certification itself.
